name: dai-memory-layer
description: Project memory for Claude Code: why decisions were made, what broke, and the code graph they attach to.

plugins.name: dai-memory
plugins.description: Records why decisions were made, what broke, and which constraints apply, then retrieves them when the agent meets unfamiliar code. Builds a call/inherit/import graph across 29 languages, so it can also answer what breaks if this changes, how A reaches B, and where untrusted input ends up.
